name: Naval Staff Briefings
author: Local campaign mod
description: Revises all 100 campaign event groups, including stock, modern and Cold War scenarios. Each event lists its three responses' Budget, Prestige and Tension effects after the question; 26 formerly two-choice events gain a third response. Disables the high-funds Parliament budget-cut event. Includes 13 modern events (1950-2050) and six Cold War events (1947-1990).
